# Minimal (`minimalClock`)

Thin, quiet time with the day and date beneath it, and room to breathe.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: clock
- Cost: light (~2.6 ms/frame at 5K on a Pro GPU)
- Built-in styles: Minimal

## Params

| key | label | kind | range / options | default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `background` | Background | menu | 0 Black · 1 Paper · 2 Soft Gradient | 0 (Black) |
| `size` | Time Size | slider | 0.6 … 1.5 | 1 |
| `date` | Date | toggle | 0 / 1 | on |
| `h24` | 24-Hour | toggle | 0 / 1 | off |
| `seconds` | Seconds | toggle | 0 / 1 | off |
| `align` | Alignment | menu | 0 Center · 1 Lower Left | 0 (Center) |
